panels.title: Reports written
panels.description: Initial incident reports produced by the Coordinator in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS reports FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'synthesis_completed' AND incident_id IN (SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE '$job' = '__all__' OR job_name = '$job' OR left(job_name, length('$job') + 1) = '$job/') AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Incomplete reports

panels.title: Conflicted reports

panels.title: Agent runs that failed or timed out
panels.description: failed, timed_out or not_dispatched runs, from the per-run view.

targets.rawSql:
WITH agent_runs AS (
WITH ev AS (
    SELECT
        id, incident_id, actor, event_type, created_at, duration_ms, ok, payload,
        lag(event_type) OVER w AS prev_type,
        lag(created_at) OVER w AS prev_at,
        lead(event_type) OVER w AS next_type
    FROM audit_events
    WHERE event_type IN ('agent_started', 'agent_completed', 'agent_failed')
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY incident_id, actor ORDER BY created_at, id)
),
finished AS (
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        actor AS agent,
        prev_at AS started_at,
        created_at AS finished_at,
        COALESCE(payload ->> 'status', CASE WHEN event_type = 'agent_failed' THEN 'failed' ELSE 'completed' END) AS status,
        payload ->> 'failure_type' AS failure_type,
        CAST(payload ->> 'confidence' AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS confidence,
        duration_ms,
        ok,
        'run' AS source
    FROM ev
    WHERE event_type IN ('agent_completed', 'agent_failed') AND prev_type = 'agent_started'
),
unfinished AS (
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        actor AS agent,
        created_at AS started_at,
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS finished_at,
        'running' AS status,
        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS failure_type,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS confidence,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS duration_ms,
        CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS ok,
        'run' AS source
    FROM ev
    WHERE event_type = 'agent_started' AND (next_type IS NULL OR next_type = 'agent_started')
),
dispatched AS (
    SELECT
        d.incident_id,
        d.payload ->> 'agent' AS agent,
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS started_at,
        d.created_at AS finished_at,
        d.payload ->> 'outcome' AS status,
        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS failure_type,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS confidence,
        d.duration_ms,
        d.ok,
        'dispatch' AS source
    FROM audit_events d
    WHERE d.event_type = 'agent_dispatch'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM audit_events r
          WHERE r.incident_id = d.incident_id
            AND r.actor = d.payload ->> 'agent'
            AND r.event_type = 'agent_started'
      )
)
SELECT * FROM finished
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM unfinished
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM dispatched
)
SELECT count(*) AS problems FROM agent_runs WHERE status IN ('failed', 'timed_out', 'not_dispatched') AND incident_id IN (SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE '$job' = '__all__' OR job_name = '$job' OR left(job_name, length('$job') + 1) = '$job/') AND $__timeFilter(finished_at)

panels.title: Approval rate
panels.description: Share of human decisions that approved the proposed fix. Empty until a reviewer decides.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE payload->>'decision' = 'approved') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS approval_rate FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'approval_decided' AND incident_id IN (SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE '$job' = '__all__' OR job_name = '$job' OR left(job_name, length('$job') + 1) = '$job/') AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Fix success rate (accuracy proxy)
panels.description: Fixes whose Jenkins re-validation passed. A live proxy: labelled verdict accuracy comes from the Week 8 evaluation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE ok) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS fix_success FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'revalidation_completed' AND incident_id IN (SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE '$job' = '__all__' OR job_name = '$job' OR left(job_name, length('$job') + 1) = '$job/') AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Verdicts
panels.description: What the Coordinator concluded, by failure type.

targets.rawSql: SELECT payload->>'verdict' AS verdict, count(*) AS reports FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'synthesis_completed' AND incident_id IN (SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE '$job' = '__all__' OR job_name = '$job' OR left(job_name, length('$job') + 1) = '$job/') AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT payload->>'decision' AS decision, count(*) AS decisions FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'approval_decided' AND incident_id IN (SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE '$job' = '__all__' OR job_name = '$job' OR left(job_name, length('$job') + 1) = '$job/') AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Fix pipeline outcomes
panels.description: How far proposed fixes got: proposal, policy, pull request, Jenkins re-validation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT stage, count(*) AS events FROM (SELECT 'proposed' AS stage, created_at, incident_id FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'remediation_proposed' UNION ALL SELECT 'policy denied', created_at, incident_id FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'policy_evaluated' AND (payload->>'allowed') = 'false' UNION ALL SELECT 'draft PR opened', created_at, incident_id FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'pull_request_created' AND ok UNION ALL SELECT 'revalidation passed', created_at, incident_id FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'revalidation_completed' AND ok UNION ALL SELECT 'revalidation failed', created_at, incident_id FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'revalidation_completed' AND NOT ok) s WHERE incident_id IN (SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE '$job' = '__all__' OR job_name = '$job' OR left(job_name, length('$job') + 1) = '$job/') AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Time to report
panels.description: Seconds from the incident being created to its initial report.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS reports, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (a.created_at - i.created_at))))::numeric, 1) AS p50_s, round((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (a.created_at - i.created_at))))::numeric, 1) AS p95_s FROM audit_events a JOIN incidents i ON i.id = a.incident_id WHERE a.event_type = 'synthesis_completed' AND a.incident_id IN (SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE '$job' = '__all__' OR job_name = '$job' OR left(job_name, length('$job') + 1) = '$job/') AND $__timeFilter(a.created_at)

panels.title: Average time to a decision
panels.description: Minutes from a fix being put in front of a reviewer to their decision.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(extract(epoch FROM (d.created_at - r.created_at)) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS minutes FROM audit_events d JOIN audit_events r ON r.incident_id = d.incident_id AND r.event_type = 'approval_requested' WHERE d.event_type = 'approval_decided' AND d.created_at >= r.created_at AND d.incident_id IN (SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE '$job' = '__all__' OR job_name = '$job' OR left(job_name, length('$job') + 1) = '$job/') AND $__timeFilter(d.created_at)

SELECT created_at AS "time", incident_id, payload->>'decision' AS decision, payload->>'reviewer' AS reviewer, payload->>'attempt' AS attempt, payload->>'comment' AS comment FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'approval_decided' AND incident_id IN (SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE '$job' = '__all__' OR job_name = '$job' OR left(job_name, length('$job') + 1) = '$job/') AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Policy denials
panels.description: Proposals the policy layer refused, and why.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "time", incident_id, payload->>'package' AS package, payload->>'violations' AS violations FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'policy_evaluated' AND (payload->>'allowed') = 'false' AND incident_id IN (SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE '$job' = '__all__' OR job_name = '$job' OR left(job_name, length('$job') + 1) = '$job/') AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Recent reports
panels.description: Score is the fused, uncalibrated value, not a probability. 'actionable' is what the remediation engine reads.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "time", incident_id, payload->>'verdict' AS verdict, (payload->>'confidence')::float AS score, payload->>'completeness' AS completeness, payload->>'conflict_status' AS conflict, payload->>'ready_for_policy_review' AS actionable FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'synthesis_completed' AND incident_id IN (SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE '$job' = '__all__' OR job_name = '$job' OR left(job_name, length('$job') + 1) = '$job/') AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Hypotheses formed by agent
panels.description: Anomaly findings: how many hypotheses each agent produced.

targets.rawSql: SELECT actor, count(*) AS hypotheses FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'hypothesis_formed' AND incident_id IN (SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE '$job' = '__all__' OR job_name = '$job' OR left(job_name, length('$job') + 1) = '$job/') AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Incident timeline (pick an incident above)
panels.description: Every audited step for the selected incident, in order: agents, dispatch, report, policy, approval, re-validation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "time", actor, event_type, ok, round(duration_ms::numeric / 1000, 1) AS seconds, summary FROM audit_events WHERE incident_id = '$incident' ORDER BY created_at, id
